title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: select user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers as a data source
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap, Microsoft's tenant notice and the cited documentation, including the disagreement about tenant-owned containers. Minor corrections should finish the role-assignment path, expand the container-lookup directions and correct a source attribution; the checklist also mentions a control absent from its table.
